incidentbot: [PAGER] P1 Heimdall Inc — dedicated pool dp-heimdall-01 reporting sustained 5xx spike (5m window). 5xx rate rising from 12% -> 38%. Pager routed to oncall.

maria_oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Pulling cluster metrics + traces.

sre_kevin: Joining. Is this tenant-isolated pool or shared? Any error patterns?

maria_oncall: Dedicated pool dp-heimdall-01, tenant heimdall-prod pinned to model redwood/heimdall-llama-accel:v2.3. Logs show backend timeouts and KV cache misses spiking during bursts.

eng_raj: Seen similar before — v2.3 has a regression where KV cache invalidation causes a synchronous regen storm under long-tail prefixes. Suggest emergency fallback to a safe variant (stateless) or pin back to v2.2. Which option has lower latency impact?

support_elena: Customer-facing update: Heimdall CS reports ~45k failed requests in last 15m, chat feature degraded for some users. They're expecting us to take corrective action now.

acct_mgr_oliver: Customer is on the line but told us to proceed if it mitigates impact. Their contract allows emergency mitigations for production safety. Please document actions.

maria_oncall: Proposed runbook: 1) Pin heimdall-prod tenant to redwood/heimdall-llama-safe:v2 (safe variant) 2) Quarantine v2.3 on dp-heimdall-01 3) If needed, route overflow to fallback pool dp-fallback-us-east-2 4) Monitor errors->target <1% within 5m. Who can run the pin?

eng_raj: I can execute the pin now. Command I'll use:

```bash
# pin model version for tenant (emergency fallback)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/heimdall-prod/pin \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RLDT" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/heimdall-llama-safe","version":"v2","reason":"emergency-fallback-5xx-spike"}'
```

sre_kevin: I'll prepare the rollback play and enable safemode routing (warm KV cache, raise concurrency limits briefly). Also watching p50/p95 latency.

maria_oncall: Proceed. Raj execute, Kevin stand by for rollback. Keep messages short and actionable.

eng_raj: Executed pin at 5234567920 — API returned 200 OK: {"status":"pinned","tenant":"heimdall-prod","model":"heimdall-llama-safe","version":"v2"}.

incidentbot: [ACTION] tenant pin applied by eng_raj at 5234567920.

support_elena: On the customer call now — they report "we see immediate reduction in failed chats". Quote from Heimdall: "Thanks, that's a big improvement."

maria_oncall: Observability update: 5xx dropped from 38% -> 0.9% within ~90s of the pin. P50 latency increased ~30% (expected), p95 stable. Can we accept latency tradeoff for now? :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:?

acct_mgr_oliver: Customer accepts the temporary performance cost. They want an RCA and ETA for safe restore to v2.3. Please capture timeline.

eng_raj: Initial triage: root cause KV cache invalidation race in v2.3 under certain prefix distributions. Working on patch PR #4891 (hotfix). Will run replay tests against dedicated pool once patch passes CI.

maria_oncall: Handoff plan: I'll stay on call for 1 hour to watch stability, then hand monitoring to sre_kevin for 12h. eng_raj to validate fix and coordinate canary. Support and CS to coordinate customer comms and runbook entry.

cs_jess: Scheduling a 2h follow-up call with Heimdall to walk through mitigation and next steps. I'll include timeline notes and action items.

maria_oncall: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-heimdall. Severity: P1. Mitigation: tenant pin to safe variant (redwood/heimdall-llama-safe:v2). Timeline notes added.

sre_kevin: Added temporary runbook tweak at 5234568100: auto-safe-fallback policy enabled for dedicated pools after 3 consecutive 5xx spikes within 10m (requires post-incident review).

maria_oncall: Next steps: ENG to ship hotfix PR -> canary on non-prod then small canary on dp-heimdall-01 (5% traffic) -> monitor 24h -> if stable, plan controlled unpin and restore. Open tasks assigned in INC ticket.

eng_raj: I'll post PR link + test results in the ticket once available.

maria_oncall: Thanks all — leaving the channel but monitoring. :white_check_mark:

incidentbot: [NOTE] thread archived to incident INC-2026-heimdall at 5234568200."
